memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Ordinary trip-specific decision: Priya chose the Thursday nonstop because it provides a materially stronger margin before her 1:00 p.m. Pacific meeting than the less expensive Denver connection. No recurring preference was established.

messages.content: The audit manager added a mandatory document review at the hotel Wednesday from 7:00 to 8:30 p.m. Replace the Wednesday return with Thursday, January 16. I still need to be available for a San Francisco meeting at 1:00 p.m. Pacific. Please recheck the complete round trip and show me the realistic return choices.

I’ll keep the selected Sunday, January 12 outbound and compare Thursday returns by their ability to protect the 1:00 p.m. meeting. Is joining from home acceptable, or do you need time to reach an office after landing?
Joining from home is fine. I need about 45 minutes from SFO to get home and would like at least 30 minutes to settle in. Airport Wi-Fi is not an acceptable plan for the meeting.

That means you should land by about 11:45 a.m. Pacific at the latest. I found two workable Thursday choices and one that misses the requirement:

• United nonstop: RDU 7:05 a.m.-SFO 10:04 a.m., $842 round trip in standard economy. That leaves 2 hours 56 minutes before the meeting, or about 2 hours 11 minutes after the estimated drive home.
• United via Denver: RDU 6:00 a.m.-DEN 8:05 a.m., DEN 9:12 a.m.-SFO 10:51 a.m., $716 round trip in standard economy. The 67-minute connection is legal, but a delay on the first segment could erase the margin.
• American via Charlotte: RDU 8:18 a.m.-CLT 9:19 a.m., CLT 10:05 a.m.-SFO 12:28 p.m., $674 round trip. This cannot get you home before 1:00 p.m.

The Sunday outbound remains United nonstop, SFO 10:35 a.m.-RDU 6:42 p.m. The quoted totals include both flight directions but not a checked bag.
Is the Denver itinerary on one ticket, and what happens to the meeting margin if the first flight is 30 minutes late?

Yes, both Denver segments are on one United ticket. A 30-minute delay into Denver would reduce the connection to about 37 minutes. United would be responsible for reaccommodation if you misconnect, but the next available routing would not preserve the 1:00 p.m. meeting. Even if you made the connection, a comparable delay into SFO would put you home around 12:06 p.m., leaving about 54 minutes.
Then the savings are not worth relying on the connection. Confirm that the nonstop is actually operating that Thursday and that 10:04 is the local arrival time.

Confirmed for Thursday, January 16: United 2169 is scheduled nonstop from Raleigh-Durham to San Francisco, departing 7:05 a.m. Eastern and arriving 10:04 a.m. Pacific. Scheduled duration is 5 hours 59 minutes. The flight is currently shown as operated by United, not a partner. Equipment and schedules can still change before departure.
What fare terms are attached to the $842 option? I need the flight credit and seat details before I authorize it.

The $842 total is standard economy for the full itinerary. It is nonrefundable, but changes are allowed without a change fee; any fare difference applies, and cancellation before departure produces a United future flight credit under the displayed terms. One carry-on and one personal item are included. A checked bag is $40 each direction if prepaid. Complimentary seat selection is available in the regular economy cabin; the current aisle choices are 24C outbound and 21D return.
Add one checked bag each way and keep those aisle seats. What is the final amount?
The airfare is $842, and two prepaid checked-bag charges add $80. The purchase total is $922. Seats 24C on the Sunday outbound and 21D on the Thursday return are included at no additional charge.
Before purchase, restate the timing against all of the work commitments. The Wednesday hotel review means the lodging and car also need to run through Thursday morning.

The itinerary now supports the full schedule: arrive RDU Sunday at 6:42 p.m., collect the rental car, and continue to the hotel near the supplier site. You remain local for Monday’s 6:30 p.m. dinner, the Tuesday and Wednesday 8:00 a.m. audit starts, the expected Wednesday 5:00 p.m. site finish, and the mandatory 7:00-8:30 p.m. document review at the hotel. Keep the room for four nights, checking out Thursday morning, and extend the rental through the Thursday airport return. The 7:05 a.m. flight requires a very early hotel departure; its 10:04 a.m. SFO arrival leaves about 2 hours 11 minutes at home before the 1:00 p.m. meeting using your stated 45-minute drive.
Proceed with the $922 complete round trip for Priya Nair. Do not purchase the hotel or rental car yet.

Booked for Priya Nair at a total charge of $922: United 2498 nonstop from San Francisco to Raleigh-Durham on Sunday, January 12, departing 10:35 a.m. Pacific and arriving 6:42 p.m. Eastern, seat 24C; and United 2169 nonstop from Raleigh-Durham to San Francisco on Thursday, January 16, departing 7:05 a.m. Eastern and arriving 10:04 a.m. Pacific, seat 21D. One prepaid checked bag is included in each direction. The ticket is standard economy, nonrefundable, changeable without a change fee subject to fare difference, with cancellation before departure returning a future flight credit under the displayed terms. The hotel and rental car were not purchased; both still need to be extended through Thursday morning.
